entities.name: Living Historians
entities.description: Historical society founded by Azusa and Reki after the Kami War to preserve knowledge through tattoos, dance, theater and song.

entities.name: Azusa
entities.description: Co-founder of the Living Historians whose diary is a sacred text.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War after which the Living Historians were founded.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where the society was founded.

events.summary: Reki and Azusa found the Living Historians after the Kami War to preserve endangered knowledge.
events.quote: The Living Historians were founded in the wake of The Kami War by Reki and Azusa
